en: Stop joking. I can't believe\nthere's a way to cross the\nborder this easily...

who infiltrated the Royal
Capital came through here as
well.

secret paths, this one is
relatively safe to travel during
this season.

you all are now "escaped
convicts who fled with the
Beast Witches."

first, but by now, you're likely
being hunted as actual
collaborators.

is only "relatively safe"; I never

danger.
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat!?

strange noises, you have a
